How long does a power station run a fridge? On the page's table, the EcoFlow DELTA 2 (Claude's and GPT's pick): about 12 h for a refrigerator, 22 h for a CPAP without humidifier, under 1 h for a microwave. Check: LiFePO4 over NMC, pure sine wave, continuous watts above your largest load. Size yours: 1billionmodels.com/portable-power-stations

Two AI models (Claude Opus 5.5, GPT 6.1 Sol) chose with no web access; nobody tested these products. Synthetic voice. AI-made video.
title: How long does a portable power station run a fridge? What Claude and GPT would buy
